title: Doctoral Scholarships
institution: The Hague Academy of International Law
about: The Hague Academy of International Law offers Doctoral Scholarships for PhD candidates from non-OECD states residing in their home country, for a research stay in The Hague from 1 July to 1 September 2027. Applications close 31 January 2027 at 23:59 Hague time.
requirements: PhD candidates from non-OECD states currently residing in their home country
Expected thesis defence by 31 December of the year after the award
Undergraduate law degree at minimum; master's preferred
Previous Doctoral Scholarship recipients are ineligible

upskill.name: the AI Governance Academy page
why: field "International law" -> AI Governance Academy, e.g. A016.02 objective "Understand the evolving international regulatory landscape for artificial intelligence" (field-level fit only; it was not in the shortlist, whose scores of 6 or more came from generic words such as "non" and "state"; the stated requirements are eligibility rules no course covers, so the Academy page is linked rather than a course)
